description: The return type of function type `F`. Use `ReturnType<typeof fn>` for a function value.
The parameter list of `F` as a labeled tuple, which can be indexed or spread.
The type produced by `await`: recursively unwraps promises and thenables.
Constructor argument tuple and instance type of a class (constructor) type.
`typeof fn<string>` fixes a generic function's type arguments before extracting types from it (TS 4.7+).
